item.title: RTT: Ca' Foscari University of Venice - 1 fixed-term tenure-track researcher in History and Institutions of Asia (Univ. VENEZIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-23 13:00
Institution: Univ. VENEZIA, Venezia
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-04 Storia internazionale e studi di area

The successful candidate will conduct research in Asian History and Institutions, focusing on the contemporary South Caucasus and Central Asia. The study will cover history, political-institutional evolution, and regional/international political dynamics, with a specific focus on energy and infrastructure (internal dynamics and external relations). The candidate is expected to enhance project-design capacity by identifying funding opportunities and submitting national and international research proposals.

item.title: RTT: Rif. 6269_All. 3 - Social Stratification and Socio-Demographic and Economic Transformations in Europe (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-08 Sociologia dei processi economici, del lavoro, dell'ambiente e del territorio

the researcher will be expected to undertake a research programme consistent with the scientific and methodological orientations of the Department and of the specific disciplinary field GSPS-08/, with particular reference to the intersection between the dimension of social stratification—including the analysis of individual socioeconomic status and economic inequalities—and broader social, demographic, and economic transformations—including changes in welfare systems and labour markets—affecting European societies.
